title: Update check
description: Taskbar chip + window reporting whether this build is current with upstream, via the broker's GET /update/check. Ships disabled; turning it on asks the serving broker to open every gate your click is allowed to open -- checking, applying, and restarting -- skipping only the ones its own config already owns, each overridable per key (update_check_enabled, update_apply_enabled, restart_enabled).
author: JohnConnorNPC
